Tensor Analysis – Practical 10 Information: • Please make sure to complete all exercises before the next lecture. • The exercises marked with [See lecture] were solved in class. • The exercises are not organised by difficulty. 10.1 Given a 2-dimensional metric tensor [gij] = ( 1 0 0 e2x ) for the a coordinate system (x1, x2) = (x, y), calculate the components of the Ricci tensor Rij. 10.2 Consider the 3-dimensional space in spherical coordinates that has arc length element ds2 = dr2 + r2dθ2 + r2 sin 2 θ dϕ2 Compute the Ricci tensor components Rkk for this coordinate system. Here (x1, x2, x3) = (r, θ, ϕ) 10.3 Given a 3-dimensional metric tensor gij =  e2u 0 0 0 e2v 0 0 0 e2w   in coordinates (x1, x2, x3) = (u, v, w). Find the Ricci tensor components Rij. Revision exercises 10.4 Consider the coordinate system having coordinates (x1, x2, x3) = (ϕ, θ, z) and position vector r = cos ϕ(sin θ + cos θ)i1 + sin ϕ(sin θ + cos θ)i2 + zi3, where i1, i2, i3 are the usual Cartesian basis vectors. (1) Find basis vectors e1, e2, e2. (2) Show that this is an orthogonal coordinate system. 1
